rules.title: Los Angeles RSO/JCO Relocation Assistance
rules.requirement: Landlords terminating a tenancy under the RSO or JCO must pay relocation assistance per unit, with amounts depending on whether the tenant is eligible or qualified, the length of tenancy and income. Payment must be made available within 15 days of service of the written notice, optionally through escrow.
rules.key_value: Effective July 1, 2026–June 30, 2027: Eligible tenant $11,000 (under 3 years) / $14,400 (3+ years or low income); Qualified tenant $23,150 / $27,400
rules.penalty: Failure to pay relocation is an affirmative defense for the tenant in an eviction action; tenants may file an LAHD complaint or pursue a private right of action.
rules.status_basis: Chart A amounts effective 2026-07-01 through 2027-06-30; increases each July 1.

requires.name: rso_or_jco_covered_tenancy
requires.text: Tenancy terminated under the RSO or JCO requiring relocation assistance

coverage.summary: Applies to tenancies terminated in circumstances requiring relocation assistance under the RSO or JCO.
coverage.exemptions_summary: Single-family dwellings owned by natural persons with no more than four dwelling units and a single-family home on a separate lot owe one month's rent; landlords may offset accumulated rent, except when the termination follows a governmental order to vacate an unpermitted dwelling.

rules.quoted_span: Payments shall be made available within fifteen (15) days of service of the written notice of eviction; however, the landlord may, at the landlord's sole discretion and at the landlord's cost, elect to pay the monetary relocation benefits through an escrow account.
